001package com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.listeners;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEntityAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DamageAPI;
007
008/**
009 * When adding to a ship, add to the ship taking the damage, NOT the one dealing it.
010 * 
011 * Should add this to a ship where possible instead of the engine as performance will be better.
012 * 
013 * @author Alex Mosolov
014 *
015 * Copyright 2019 Fractal Softworks, LLC
016 */
017public interface DamageTakenModifier {
018        
019        /**
020         * Modifications to damage should ONLY be made using damage.getModifier().
021         * 
022         * param can be:
023         * null
024         * DamagingProjectileAPI
025         * BeamAPI
026         * EmpArcEntityAPI
027         * Something custom set by a script
028         * 
029         * @return the id of the stat modification to damage.getModifier(), or null if no modification was made
030         */
031        String modifyDamageTaken(Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
032                                                DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit);
033        
034}
